name: Basotho Papa

name: Basotho Moroho
description: Moroho, wild or cultivated leafy greens cooked simply, is a genuine Basotho staple side, traditionally served alongside papa.

name: Basotho Sorghum Porridge
description: Ting, a fermented sorghum porridge, is a genuine Basotho breakfast staple, built here on real sorghum flour.

Cook over medium-low heat, stirring often, 12-15 minutes until thick and smooth.
